driver_style — DRIVE traffic op

• Data kinds: none → table (an op determined by its arguments alone — it takes no image or data input)

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.driver_style(kind: 'str', seed: 'Optional[int]' = None) -> 'Dict[str, float]' (to call the implementation directly, import drivetraffic; drivetraffic.driver_style(kind: 'str', seed: 'Optional[int]' = None) -> 'Dict[str, float]'; from the registry, opsdrive.get("driver_style"))

Usage

Returns the parameters of 3 driving styles ("careful" / "normal" / "sloppy"). All values are assumptions (no source).

Keys: IDM's v0, T, a, b, s0, delta, reaction_delay [s], lateral wobble (OU process) wobble_theta [1/s] and wobble_sigma [m/√s] (stationary standard deviation σ/sqrt(2θ) = 0.05 / 0.11 / 0.28 m), speed_noise (relative unevenness of the desired speed), length 4.5 m (assumed), kind. The return value can be passed as is as one vehicle to idm_platoon_simulate.

Given seed, the main values are multiplied by a uniform ±10% individual difference (deterministic via default_rng(seed)). With None, nominal values. Ordering properties (gate): at nominal values careful has the largest T and s0 and the smallest reaction delay, sloppy the opposite, and the stationary SD of wobble is careful < normal < sloppy.

Raises ValueError: unknown kind.
